scope: Additive Home Village TH18 reference delta. It extends the 2026-09-17 ledger without rewriting it.
game_version: client build 18.600.3 for secondary numeric values; official June 2026 update publication confirms level availability

sources.limitations: Independent fan table reports Monolith L1–5 HP, DPS, cost, duration and TH requirement. It does not publish its percentage bonus, projectile timing, target-tie ordering, cancellation or exact damage-resolution sequence.

Community-maintained table supplies L5 base impact damage, 15% bonus damage, cadence, range and target class but has no published date or immutable client build. Its values are used only where the dated client-build table does not expose them.

official_deltas.behavior: Official June 2026 release notes list Monolith Level 5 among the new building levels; the note does not publish its numerical table.

changed_values.previous_state: absent from the normalized catalogue generated from the 2026-09-17 frozen upstream snapshot
changed_values.replacement: normal level added from a hash-pinned secondary observation; official source confirms the level exists but not its numbers
changed_values.justification: The official 2026-06-15 release note postdates the upstream snapshot and confirms L5. The 18.600.3 table dated 2026-09-16 supplies the current numeric fields.

known_uncertainties: Monolith percentage bonus, projectile timing and target-order behavior remain unimplemented and are not promoted to fidelity evidence.
No documented public L5 sprite asset has been pinned locally; this data delta does not claim Viewer asset completeness.
conclusion: This is an additive versioned reference. The 2026-09-17 reference remains preserved byte-for-byte and must never regain sole active-reference status without an explicit migration.
